tools.name: generate_cosmic_recipe
tools.description: Search the whole local recipe catalog by keywords, cuisine, diet and element. Returns 5 matches by default; limit and offset (no maximum) page through every match, and totalMatching reports how many there are. Authenticated calls debit 2.5 of each ESMS token (10 total), settled only when the search succeeds; without an idempotency key every call charges. Pass arguments._meta.idempotencyKey to retry safely: identical arguments within 24 hours replay the original settlement instead of charging again, and the result's billing field reports what happened. Optional arguments._meta.apiKey or MCP_USER_API_KEY (or ALCHM_MCP_USER_API_KEY) authenticates a caller; arguments._meta.caller identifies the client. Anonymous reads use demo mode. Credentials are validated only with the operator's DATABASE_URL configured.

ignoreSavedProfile.description: When true, bypasses automatic filtering based on the caller's saved dietary preferences and allergens.

limit.description: Recipes to return. Defaults to 5; there is no maximum, so a large value returns every match.

offset.description: Matching recipes to skip, to page through totalMatching.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional retry key for paid tools. Reusing it with identical arguments within 24 hours replays the original settlement instead of charging again; reusing it with different arguments, or later, is rejected.
